title_as_printed: Life expectancy with and without dementia in persons with mild cognitive impairment in the community

Task_Type.reason: Population-based cohort epidemiology: multistate life tables, with Gompertz-regression hazard ratios, give life expectancy with and without dementia. No classifier is fitted.

Category.reason: Data come from the population-based Rotterdam Study: cohort follow-up, neuropsychological assessment, and linked GP and mortality records.

Validation_Type.reason: No predictive model is validated. Convention: V2.

Sample_N_Approx.quote: After excluding participants without follow-up time after the MCI assessment, 648 participants with MCI and 6410 without MCI remained

Publication_Year.reason: Issue year 2022 (J Am Geriatr Soc. 2022;70:481-489). The paper was accepted in September 2021 and is (c) 2021, so 2021 would also be acceptable.

ADNI_Dependent.reason: The only dataset is the Rotterdam Study; ADNI is not used.
